description: This file defines a Flutter widget named JobCard, which displays job posting details as a card with title, subtitle, and optional trailing icon. It references external models and packages for UI components, data formatting, and models.

classes.name: JobCard
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays the details of a JobPost object in a card layout, including title, hourly rate, hours, nurses needed, optional distance, and provides tap interaction.

methods.name: JobCard
methods.description: Constructor for the JobCard widget, initializing with job data, tap callback, and optional trailing widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the JobCard, presenting job information formatted with currency and conditional distance display.
